title: Mito-Polaritons Meet the Resource Boundary: Exact Hopfield A^2 Invariants, Thermodynamic Maintenance Horizons, and Constructive Lean 4 Certificates for the 71-THz Mitochondrial Quantum State
abstract: We apply our operational coherence-maintenance and resource-boundary framework (ARR-2025-2AQXS44H6Z8GQAG2 and companion 2025-2026 AIRR.SCIENCE records) to audit the 71.0-THz mitochondrial cristae mito-polariton model of Yang, Gu, and Song (bioRxiv:10.64898/2026.09.10.750628v1, Sep. 2026). Backed by a zero-floating-point verification suite (MITO-POLARITON-BOUND-CERT-1.0) comprising 18 constructive Lean 4.35.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 Classical.choice), 16 canonical JSON certificates, and 30 unit/forgery/AST tests, we prove: (i) at nu_- = 71 THz and omega_0 = 87 THz, coupling enters the ultrastrong regime (eta = 1264/6177 ~ 0.2046 > 0.1), where the gauge-invariant Hopfield A^2 Thomas-Reiche-Kuhn sum rule predicts an upper polariton at 7569/71 ~ 106.61 THz (+3.61 THz above RWA's 103 THz), testable in D2O; (ii) at T = 310 K, bulk-water picosecond dephasing exceeds the mitochondrial ATP power budget by 5e5, separating zero-maintenance passive vacuum-dressed polaritons (Regime I, C_Delta = 0) from active non-equilibrium coherence (Regime II, requiring kappa_down <= 2e6 s^-1); (iii) cristae collar suppression (RIP-U) cannot eliminate an irreducible omega = 0 Davies pure-dephasing floor; (iv) for N bosonic CH2 stretches in the vacuum regime (n_th < 2e-6 at 310 K), exact 4x4 Bogoliubov diagonalization of the Coulomb-gauge A^2 Hamiltonian yields lower-polariton matter weight w_mat^Coul = 7569/12610 ~ 0.6002 > 1/2, forcing local Markovian dephasing into N-1 dark modes at rate w_mat^Coul ((N-1)/N) gamma_loc > (1/4) gamma_loc (zero 1/N collective protection), while an S-lamella coupled cristae stack outperforms factorized single-bilayer water-band shielding whenever C_S(delta+beta)+r < 1; and (v) a four-test experimental falsification matrix discriminates classical artifacts, Regime I, and Regime II.
